contributions.statement: Run each parallel search agent on its own git branch and pass only short attempt summaries to the orchestrator.
contributions.evidence: §3.4 Table 2: orchestrator-guided scaling beats fixed scaling on 4/5 tasks, single runs, Minimax only; Table 1 win counts are internally inconsistent and baselines weakened.

reason: Branch-per-agent isolation is already shown with a paired significance test in 2609.38345 and is an AGENTS.md rule here; the rest is single-run optimisation scores on scalar-evaluated toy tasks with inconsistent win counts.
